independent_cohort_policy: Never used for weight training/checkpoint selection. Isolated fragment findings informed the final repeat-support detector guard; not an untouched test of that guard.
classification_reports: Physical-length-weighted token classifications; macro averages exclude ID 0
raw_reports: Class-aware raw observed-edge length IoU >= 0.5, one-to-one assignment; all base proposals including abstained proposals; no confidence filtering
thread_detection_policy: At least four constituent line/arc spans in each candidate thread side; detected compounds always choose their most likely class
